name: Event Analytics
summary: Event ingest, sessionization, and a funnel, retention, and cohort query pack over your own Postgres.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: ANALYTICS_SESSION_GAP_MINUTES
env.description: Inactivity gap that ends a session. 30 is conventional; changing it changes every historical session count.

env.name: ANALYTICS_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: Days raw events are kept. Rollups outlive them, so long-range trends survive the purge.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Sessionize new events and refresh daily aggregates. Off-peak, because it scans a day of raw events.
